title: hushrun.policy.explain/v2
description: Output of `hushrun policy explain --format json`: the checks hushrun.yaml requires, its `deploy` settings, and, [ADR 0031 amendments 1 and 2] whether the repository's signers answer makes it CI-only (T-16, L-13). [ADR 0062] v2 has no stage: a repository has one pipeline.

deploy.description: hushrun.yaml's `deploy`, or null when it has none.

requirements.description: The checks hushrun.yaml requires: `deploy.require`, else every check with `run`.

accepts.description: Whose events count for it: `ci` while the repository is CI-only (T-16); `signers`, members' machines, agents and the repository's CI (T-15), otherwise, including when `ciOnly.checked` is false.

ciOnly.description: Whether the repository is CI-only (T-16), as the repository's signers answer says (L-13): asked of the server, or read from `--signers FILE`. `checked` is false when there was no server to ask or it didn't answer; `reason` says why.

source.description: The server's URL, or the file's path.

statementChecked.description: Whether the answer's statement was checked against the log key hushrun.yaml pins (T-9); false, with a warning, when it pins none.

now.description: Whether the repository is CI-only now.

since.description: When the current period began, while the repository is CI-only.

periods.description: Every period the repository was CI-only, oldest first; `until` is absent while it is. An answer that lists periods per stage is read as their union.
